title: Built a simple web game with Claude out of curiosity
author: junkbots_studio
selftext:
Hi!

First off let me say I've been a software developer for 15 years mostly creating software and doing games in my spare time as a hobby. I've been using AI in my work for the past year but wasn't quite sure where the capabilities stood with games so I thought I'd try it out.

Not exactly a complicated game to test it out with, but was a simple enough idea to bring forth and try out this new workflow where I'm mainly driving design.

The game contains:

* An upgrade tree with 9 upgrades
* 8 different paint cosmetics
* 8 different head cosmetics

If you want to try it out, you can play it here: [https://playgama.ai/play/jijiecvdnbvhsw](https://playgama.ai/play/jijiecvdnbvhsw)
